mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.board_id AS boardId, c.author_id AS authorId, m.name AS authorName, CASE WHEN c.deleted_by IS NULL THEN c.content ELSE NULL END AS content, c.deleted_by AS deletedBy, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM BOARD_COMMENT c JOIN MEMBER m ON c.author_id = m.member_id WHERE c.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_COMMENT (board_id, author_id, content) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{authorId}, #{content})
